'''Jeremy Oakes''' (DeckTech handle '''JerUNH''') finished 100th on Day 1 of the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="tr-d1356">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-16-rexbanner-goes-to-d-cond1356/ rexbanner-goes-to-d-con], DeckTech (Andy "RexBanner7" Klema, 16 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-16-rexbanner-goes-to-d-cond1356/ GitHub Pages].</ref> He roomed at [[DecipherCon 2000]] with [[Andy Klema]] and [[Karl Sundberg]].<ref name="tr-d1356" /> [[Hayes Hunter]] named him for representing Kashyyyk.<ref name="tr-d1328">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-11-hayes-hunters-dcon-props-slopsd1328/ hayes-hunters-dcon-props-slops], DeckTech (Eric "bounty22" Hunter, 11 October 2000). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261025191937/https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-11-hayes-hunters-dcon-props-slopsd1328/ Internet Archive].</ref> He directed the [[2001 Meriden Tournament]] and posted tournament reports from [[FreedomCon]] 2001.<ref name="tr-d1876">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-11-meriden-ct-03-10-2001-td-reportd1876/ meriden-ct-03-10-2001-td-report], DeckTech (Jeremy "JerUNH" Oakes, 11 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-11-meriden-ct-03-10-2001-td-reportd1876/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
